title: Polynomial chart with prescribed fibre dimension
statement: For affine schemes X and T, a locally finitely presented morphism f : X ⟶ T, a point y : X, and a natural number n equal to the dimension of the fibre at y, there is an affine open U containing y and a locally finitely presented, locally quasi-finite morphism e : U ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift (Fin n)) T whose composite with projection equals U.ι ≫ f.

proof.text: Use affine_coordinate_fibre_dimension_eq to transfer the supplied fibre dimension to the canonical fibre prime of the map Γ(T,⊤)→Γ(X,⊤). Finite presentation of f supplies finite presentation, hence finite type, of this map.

Apply Algebra.exists_quasiFinite_over_polynomial_algebra to this prime and the supplied n. It gives g outside the prime and a polynomial algebra map to the localization away from g, finite type and quasi-finite at every prime.

Apply exists_chart_of_localized_polynomial_map to obtain e on the fixed affine basic open X.basicOpen g, with the two morphism properties and the composite identity. The inverse-image identity X.map_PrimeSpectrum_basicOpen_of_affine turns g outside the coordinate prime into y∈X.basicOpen g. Use this open and e as the witnesses.

proof_origin.place: The same affine polynomial-chart construction, with both geometric bridges proved explicitly in the delivered modules. The dimension bridge uses fibre homeomorphisms instead of pullbackSpecIso.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_quasiFinite_polynomial_chart_data
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine T]
    (f : X ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (y : X) (n : ℕ)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber y) = (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, IsAffine U.toScheme ∧ y ∈ U ∧
      ∃ e : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T,
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation e ∧ LocallyQuasiFinite e ∧
      e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T ↘ T) = U.ι ≫ f
